shortDescription: Module for setup of BackupConfiguration Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: aws_access_key
options.description: Aws access key id. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: aws_bucket_id
options.description: Aws bucket. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: aws_bucket_region
options.description: The name of the aws region associated with the bucket. Field introduced in 21.1.5, 22.1.1, 22.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: aws_secret_access
options.description: Aws secret access key. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: backup_file_prefix
options.description: Prefix of the exported configuration file. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: backup_passphrase
options.description: Default passphrase to encrypt sensitive fields for configuration export and periodic backup. The same passphrase must be provided to import the configuration. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: bundle_mode
options.description: By default, json backups are generated. When this flag is enabled, bundle backups will be generated. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: maximum_backups_stored
options.description: Rotate the backup files based on this count. Allowed values are 1-20. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of backup configuration. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: remote_directory
options.description: Directory at remote destination with write permission for ssh user. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: remote_file_transfer_protocol
options.description: Remote file transfer protocol type. Enum options - SCP, SFTP. Field introduced in 22.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in basic (allowed values- scp, sftp) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as SCP.

options.name: remote_hostname
options.description: Remote destination. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: s3_bucket_folder
options.description: The folder name in s3 bucket where backup will be stored. Field introduced in 30.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: save_local
options.description: Local backup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: ssh_user_ref
options.description: Access credentials for remote destination. It is a reference to an object of type cloudconnectoruser. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: upload_to_remote_host
options.description: Remote backup. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: upload_to_s3
options.description: Cloud backup. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.
